plain: Everyone needs to wear their ID badge in the office.
legal: All personnel shall display their identification badges at all times while on the Company's premises.

plain: Visitors must sign in at reception.
legal: All visitors shall register at reception upon arrival.

plain: The office is open from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays.
legal: The Office shall be open from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays.

plain: You need permission to work in the office on weekends.
legal: Access to the Office during weekends shall be subject to prior authorization.

plain: Please clean up the kitchen after using it.
legal: Employees shall leave the kitchen in a clean condition after use.

plain: Food left in the fridge is thrown out every Friday.
legal: Food remaining in the refrigerator shall be disposed of every Friday.

plain: Don't leave laptops unattended in public places.
legal: Employees shall not leave laptops unattended in public places.

plain: All expense claims must be submitted within 30 days.
legal: All expense claims shall be submitted within thirty (30) days of the expense being incurred.

plain: Meals on business trips are covered up to $60 a day.
legal: Meal expenses incurred during business travel shall be reimbursed up to $60 per day.

plain: Book flights through the company travel portal.
legal: All flights shall be booked through the Company's travel portal.

plain: Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours.
legal: Economy class travel shall be required for flights of less than six (6) hours.

plain: Gifts from suppliers worth more than $50 must be reported.
legal: Any gift from a supplier with a value exceeding $50 shall be reported.

plain: Don't accept cash gifts from anyone.
legal: Employees shall not accept gifts of cash from any person.

plain: Tell your manager if you have a conflict of interest.
legal: Employees shall disclose any conflict of interest to their manager.

plain: Company cars can't be used for personal trips.
legal: Company vehicles shall not be used for personal purposes.

plain: Report any accident at work to your supervisor on the same day.
legal: Any workplace accident shall be reported to the Employee's supervisor on the day of its occurrence.

plain: Fire exits must be kept clear at all times.
legal: Fire exits shall be kept unobstructed at all times.

plain: Fire drills happen every 6 months.
legal: Fire drills shall be conducted every six (6) months.

plain: When the alarm sounds, leave the building by the nearest exit.
legal: Upon the sounding of the alarm, all occupants shall evacuate the Building by the nearest exit.

plain: Don't use the elevators during a fire.
legal: Elevators shall not be used in the event of a fire.

plain: Meeting rooms can be booked for up to 2 hours at a time.
legal: Meeting rooms may be reserved for a maximum of two (2) hours per booking.

plain: Cancel your room booking if you don't need it anymore.
legal: Employees shall cancel any room reservation that is no longer required.

plain: Personal calls should be kept short.
legal: Personal telephone calls shall be kept to a minimum.

plain: Dress code is business casual, except on Fridays.
legal: The dress code shall be business casual, except on Fridays.

plain: Only IT can install software on company computers.
legal: Software shall be installed on Company computers exclusively by the IT department.

plain: Change your password every 90 days.
legal: Passwords shall be changed every ninety (90) days.

plain: Report suspicious emails to security@northwind-labs.com.
legal: Suspicious emails shall be reported to security@northwind-labs.com.

plain: Remote workers must use the VPN.
legal: Employees working remotely shall connect through the Company's virtual private network.

plain: Don't post confidential company information on social media.
legal: Employees shall not disclose confidential information of the Company on social media.

plain: Only the communications team may speak to journalists on behalf of the company.
legal: Only members of the Communications team are authorized to speak to journalists on behalf of the Company.

plain: Performance reviews happen twice a year.
legal: Performance reviews shall be conducted semi-annually.

plain: Managers must hold a one-on-one with each team member every month.
legal: Each manager shall hold a monthly one-to-one meeting with each member of the manager's team.

plain: Flexible hours are allowed as long as you're available between 10 am and 3 pm.
legal: Flexible working hours shall be permitted, provided that employees are available between 10 am and 3 pm.

plain: Dogs are welcome in the office on Wednesdays if they are well-behaved.
legal: Well-behaved dogs shall be permitted in the Office on Wednesdays.

plain: Smoking is only allowed in the marked area outside.
legal: Smoking shall be permitted only in the designated outdoor area.

plain: Alcohol may only be served at approved company events.
legal: Alcohol shall be served only at Company events that have been duly approved.

plain: Employees can buy company products at a 30% discount.
legal: Employees shall be entitled to purchase Company products at a discount of 30%.

plain: The discount is for personal use, not for resale.
legal: The employee discount is granted for personal use only and shall not be used to purchase goods for resale.

plain: Lost and found items are kept for 30 days.
legal: Lost property shall be retained for thirty (30) days.

plain: Desks must be cleared at the end of each day.
legal: All desks shall be cleared at the end of each working day.

plain: Whistleblowers will be protected from retaliation.
legal: No employee shall suffer retaliation for making a disclosure in good faith under this Policy.

plain: Reports can be made anonymously.
legal: Reports may be submitted anonymously.

plain: Everyone must complete anti-bribery training every year.
legal: All employees shall complete anti-bribery training annually.

plain: Company credit cards are for business expenses only.
legal: Company credit cards shall be used exclusively for business expenses.

plain: Any misuse of a company card may lead to dismissal.
legal: Any misuse of a Company credit card may result in dismissal.

plain: Requests for parental leave should be made 8 weeks in advance.
legal: Requests for parental leave shall be submitted not less than eight (8) weeks in advance.

plain: Hybrid employees must be in the office at least 3 days a week.
legal: Hybrid employees shall attend the Office for not less than three (3) days per week.

plain: The parking garage is reserved for staff with permits.
legal: The parking garage is reserved for staff holding a valid permit.

plain: Don't prop open security doors.
legal: Security doors shall not be propped open.

plain: Annual leave can't be taken during the last two weeks of December without approval.
legal: Annual leave shall not be taken during the final two (2) weeks of December without prior approval.

plain: Employees must disclose any criminal conviction that happens during employment.
legal: Employees shall disclose any criminal conviction occurring during the course of their employment.

plain: Hiring decisions are based on merit only.
legal: All hiring decisions shall be made solely on the basis of merit.

plain: Equal pay is given for equal work.
legal: Employees performing equal work shall receive equal remuneration.

plain: Staff can request adjustments for a disability at any time.
legal: Employees may request reasonable adjustments in respect of a disability at any time.

plain: Phones must be on silent during meetings.
legal: Mobile telephones shall be set to silent mode during meetings.

plain: Recording meetings requires everyone's consent.
legal: Meetings shall not be recorded without the consent of all participants.

plain: The cafeteria serves lunch from noon to 2 pm.
legal: The cafeteria shall serve lunch from noon until 2 pm.

plain: Use the bike racks, not the lobby, to park bicycles.
legal: Bicycles shall be parked in the bicycle racks and not in the lobby.

plain: Any policy breach should be reported to HR.
legal: Any breach of this Policy shall be reported to the Human Resources department.

plain: This policy is reviewed every year by the leadership team.
legal: This Policy shall be reviewed annually by the leadership team.
